description_en: Parses a blind watermark added by Intelligent Media Management (IMM)
name: DecodeBlindWatermark

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the blind-watermarked image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
已加盲水印图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the original image before the blind watermark was added.

This parameter is not required for the DWT and DWT_IBG algorithm models.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
添加盲水印前图片的OSS URI。

对于DWT和DWT_IBG算法模型无需设置此参数。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: original_image_uri

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI to which the parsed blind watermark image is saved.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
解析盲水印后图片保存到的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: target_uri

parameters.help_en:
The quality of the output image. Default value: 90. Valid values: 70 to 100.

A higher quality value results in a larger image size and better watermark parsing quality
parameters.help_zh:
输出图片的质量，默认值为90，取值范围为70~100。

质量越高，图片尺寸越大，水印解析质量越高
parameters.name: image_quality

parameters.help_en:
The watermark algorithm model. Default value: FFT. Valid values: FFT, FFT_FULL, DWT, and DWT_IBG.

For more information about the differences between algorithm models, see the algorithm model section in EncodeBlindWatermark (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138800.html).

When adding and parsing a blind watermark for the same image, you must use the same algorithm. Otherwise, the watermark cannot be parsed
parameters.help_zh:
水印算法模型，默认值为FFT，可选值包括FFT、FFT_FULL、DWT和DWT_IBG。

关于不同算法模型的区别，请参见EncodeBlindWatermark (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138800.html)中的算法模型。

对同一张图片，添加盲水印和解析盲水印时必须使用同一种算法，否则图片的水印无法进行解析
parameters.name: model

TargetUri.description_en: The OSS URI of the parsed watermark image
TargetUri.description_zh: 解析出的水印图片的OSS URI
